title: Create a diagnostic failure atlas for candidate mechanisms
question: Which deliberately wrong generators pass individual metrics while failing joint held-out tests?
rationale: Exposing easy false positives can prevent promising-looking but weak decipherment claims from dominating effort.
distinctness: Focus is failure characterization across a finite declared control set; it does not claim novelty for copy/mutate generation itself.

prior_work_check.scope: Bounded launch-source catalog and current seed directions inspected; this does not establish world-first novelty.

first_step: Write a small table of three fixed mechanisms and predeclare two held-out diagnostics before execution.
limitations: Candidate suggestion only; detailed protocol and execution are future work.
Designated seed: zero competitive allocations; evidence-tier baseline awaits official assessment.
attribution: voynich.win launch curation, AI-assisted by OpenAI Codex; exposed precise model version not recorded
